text:
Type: three-seat sofa with track arms
Use: seating, lounging, family gatherings; living room, family room
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, contemporary
Materials: woven fabric upholstery, solid birch wooden legs
Colors: off-white, very light cool grey, light natural wood
Shape: long straight frame, three loose back and seat cushions, slim track arms with a side pocket, round tapered wooden legs, raised and light
Feel: airy, bright, calm, fresh
Goes with: light wood floors, white walls, soft grey or pastel textiles; Scandinavian or minimalist living rooms

product.name: NORSBORG
product.description: Big or small, colourful or neutral. The sofa comes in many shapes, styles and sizes so that you can easily find the one that suits you and your family best.
